messages:
maya: Quick usability note from a 1:1 — new users hit the empty "sample projects" workspace and aren’t sure what to do next. They stare at the muted card with the tiny 'Add sample' link and ask if the product shipped half-finished :grimacing: jamie: Yep saw that in session 4 too. The CTA blends into the background when there are no samples. Also the copy 'Add sample' is vague — they didn't realize it's a gallery of templates they can import. oliver: Agreed. Two quick problems: (1) visual affordance — CTA contrast and size, (2) discoverability — people expect a preview or example tiles, not just text. zane: Accessibility nits from the lab: keyboard users can't tab to the empty-state card action until they intentionally focus the container. Focus order is off. Screen-reader reads "empty library" but doesn't announce an action. maya: Proposed changes: 1) Replace muted link with a prominent primary button 'Browse sample projects' 2) show 3 preview thumbnails (mock images) inline to demonstrate what a sample is 3) add short explainer copy: 'Import a sample to get a working inference app and prompts' 4) ensure the button is first tabbable element and has aria-describedby to the explainer. lydia: Love that. Small copy suggestion: use "Import a sample project" (more explicit). Also add a small "Or create your own" tertiary button for people who already know what they want. jamie: +1. Also we should A/B test: Variant A (primary button + 3 thumbnails) vs Variant B (primary button + single large illustration + micro-copy). Measure click-through and time-to-first-model-call. oliver: UX follow-ups: can the thumbnails be lazy-loaded to avoid extra bundle cost? And we need alt text for each thumbnail. zane: For keyboard/screenreader, implement the action as a real button with clear label and an aria-live polite patch when import completes. Example aria snippet: ```html Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and quickstart README.
``` maya: Nice. For color/contrast, design propose increasing the primary token to our primary-700 and bumping padding to 12px so it looks clickable on mobile. Also add subtle motion when hovering to signal affordance. lydia: Accessibility check: make sure focus outline is visible (do not rely on color only). Also ensure the tertiary 'create your own' is still reachable via keyboard and has role=button semantics. jamie: Action items: maya to iterate mocks, oliver to prototype HTML/CSS, zane to add keyboard/a11y test cases to the onboarding e2e suite, lydia to draft the microcopy variants. I'll create a tracking ticket for the A/B test and funnel metrics. maya: I'll share two mock variants by EOD Thurs. Quick mock note: Variant A uses 3 real sample thumbnails (resizable), Variant B uses an illustration + bullet benefits. oliver: I'll spin up a small static prototype in the incubator branch and include the aria snippet; will ping once ready for review. zane: Adding tests: keyboard nav, focus order, screen reader announcement on import success, and ensuring import button meets contrast ratio 4.5:1. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3421 "Improve empty-state sample import flow" assigned to maya/oliver/zane/lydia. Due 2026-04-02. :white_check_mark: maya: Thanks — will post mocks in #design-review when ready. :sparkles:
